dimensions.evidenceA: The LORD made and rested in the seven-day creation sequence.
dimensions.evidenceB: Israel served in Egypt and the LORD brought Israel out.
dimensions.label: Stated ground

evidence.observation: The command says to remember the Sabbath and grounds its holiness in the LORD making heaven, earth, and sea in six days and resting the seventh.
The command says to observe the Sabbath and grounds it in remembering slavery in Egypt and the LORD’s mighty hand and outstretched arm.

record.tension: Exodus grounds Sabbath in the LORD’s creation rest, while Deuteronomy grounds it in Israel’s remembered slavery and deliverance.
record.title: Why is Israel commanded to keep Sabbath?
